title: PREPARING FOR AI: Introducing the 'AI Podcast for Everybody'
description: Send us Fan Mail Two British friends and self apointed 'AI experts', sitting in China and watching artificial intelligence transform the world from a unique vantage point. This is 'Preparing for AI- The AI Podcast for Everybody'. It's not your usual AI podcast, this is not about benchmarks or clickbaity takes on the latest AI news – it's all about bringing a fresh perspective that explores the human and social impact of AI, bridging Eastern and Western approaches to technology development, delivered with honesty and accessibility. Matt Cartwright and Jimmy Rhodes have reimagined their podcast journey with this reset episode, candidly admitting their original first recording was "rubbish" while highlighting how far they've come. With Matt focusing on human and social impacts and Jimmy bringing his software development expertise, they create conversations that balance technical understanding with broader societal implications. You won't find impenetrable jargon or ivory tower discussions here – just straightforward explorations of how artificial intelligence is reshaping our world. Their British humor shines through as they tackle everything from utopian possibilities to dystopian risks, maintaining critical perspectives particularly toward industry giants like OpenAI and Sam Altman. Living in China provides Matt and Jimmy unique insights into a society where AI is already deeply embedded in daily life. They describe scenarios most Western listeners might find futuristic – robots delivering room service food that was ordered through AI systems and delivered by algorithm-guided couriers – while examining the broader implications of the technological race between global powers. The hosts recommend several standout episodes for new listeners, including their exploration of AI Utopia versus Dystopia, interviews with everyday AI users who've transformed their work through these tools, conversations with China-focused researchers, and an innovative episode where they interviewed AI systems directly. Throughout these discussions, they maintain a critical but balanced perspective on both tremendous potential and serious risks. Whether you're AI-curious or seeking deeper understanding of how these technologies affect society, "Preparing for AI" offers an entertaining, thought-provoking entry point. Join these two friends as they guide you through the rapidly evolving landscape of artificial intelligence with honesty, humor, and genuine insight.
summary: The reset 'episode one' explains the podcast's purpose and picks its best back-catalogue. Matt — the human-and-social-impact half, a self-described 'complete conspiracy realist' who thinks Sam Altman 'may be the devil' — and Jimmy, the software-developer optimist now 'vibe coding' hand-in-glove with AI, frame the show as the accessible 'AI podcast for everybody' from their vantage point in China, where robots deliver hotel takeaways and algorithms run daily life. They recommend the Utopia/Dystopia two-parter, Tech Optimist, election interference, the AI interviews and the China episodes.
